scope: Local SSR fixture and installed Privy SDK; public provider metadata fetched live with CAPTCHA explicitly disabled in the fixture response only. OTP/passkey provider endpoints and application responses, including durable wallet status/retry projections, are synthetic. Wallet fixtures assert no browser provider creation, signing, funding or transfer call. Real Chromium virtual-authenticator ceremonies exercise native passkey creation/assertion; real PostgreSQL acceptance is recorded separately. No real CAPTCHA validation, email delivery, genuine provider login/link/wallet creation, hosted session, physical device or complete WCAG conformance evidence.
